items.title: Frank Adams Interview, 1959-01-20
items.q: There was another riot, Seymour or somebody, did you ever hear of that one, Sheik? No.

ctx.x: So anyway, so I was told now, they'd like to have a riot then again, on the kind of pushing them, see. So they're making everybody get back, he couldn't go see. Well, I didn't want to see, I just passed by there, and the time on that side when I seen all and hear about what it was all about, and I stood at the next second corner and heard about what it was, and I kept on going. I said, I didn't want to get no straight shots, even if somebody else was me. I never did run up to a crowd or get away from a crowd,…

Yeah, I heard that about one, maybe the same fellow, George Lewis told me. Yeah. There was another riot, Seymour or somebody, did you ever hear of that one, Sheik? No. Bunk told me about it. You heard of the Persia one. I mean, that ain't been too long. No.
About 20 years. Seymour, I don't remember after Seymour. The Persia was about 20 years ago.
